description: Bruitages et musiques du monde Le Manoir Harrington (dossier /83/ des cartes SD).

sons.prompt: 1920s London mystery jingle, muted jazz trumpet and piano, foggy and elegant
Quiet English manor at night, grandfather clock ticking, distant foghorn on the Thames, rain on windows, seamless loop
Crystal chime with a soft mechanical click, precise and elegant
Short dull mechanical clunk, gentle failure
Electromechanical lock releasing, heavy door unlocking, 1920s
Old electric alarm bell ringing loudly in a manor hallway
Electrical buzz dying out, lights switching off with a thump, everything goes quiet
Old generator coughing, then starting and humming steadily, lights buzzing back on
Antique jewellery box mechanism unlocking with several clicks, lid opening, music box note
Old man groaning softly as he regains consciousness, fabric rustling
Triumphant 1920s orchestral fanfare with brass, mystery solved
Police whistles in the fog, a car driving away, distant Big Ben chime
